messages:
Alice Chen: Heads up — our "Bootcamp Panel" is scheduled Wed 10:00–12:00 but three customers (Nova, HelixThera, Meridian) have office hours that overlap. Need to rebalance panelists across sessions so customers still get dedicated time. Who can flex?

Raj Patel: I can move from 11–12 to 9–10 if that helps. Not super keen on mornings but doable.

Priya Nair: I’m booked with onboarding deep-dive 10–11 for Nova. Can’t move that one.

Marco Ruiz: I can split and do panel A (10:00–10:40) + panel C (11:20–12:00) if we shorten panels to 40m each and add 20m Q&A buffer.

Alice Chen: @Marco that could work. We’d need someone to cover the 10:40–11:20 slot or turn it into an open Q&A.

Elena (cs_ops): Quick note — several customers asked for hands-on breakout during the hour. If we split, we should keep one continuous 60m session for HelixThera for their hands-on.

Raj Patel: Ok, then propose:

```
9:00-10:00 — Pre-panel prep (internal)
10:00-11:00 — Panel 1 (HelixThera hands-on + 20m QA) — Marco + Alice
11:00-12:00 — Panel 2 (Meridian + Nova overflow) — Raj + Priya
```

Raj Patel: That preserves Nova’s 10–11 slot by moving me earlier and keeps HelixThera hands-on intact.

Priya Nair: Works for me if Raj takes the hands-on kickoff for Meridian. I’ll join the second half for Nova follow-ups.

Alice Chen: Love it. Can someone update the calendar and ping the customers? @calendar-bot can you attempt the swap and flag any conflicts? :pray:

calendar-bot: Attempting event update for event id event_2026_bootcamp. Found conflict: HelixThera requested a Zoom breakout room; original room already reserved 10:00-11:30. Suggesting alternate room "Maple-Training-2" for 10:00-11:00.

Elena (cs_ops): I’ll email HelixThera and Nova to confirm the revised times and ask if they still want the hands-on lab. I’ll also reserve Maple-Training-2.

Marco Ruiz: If HelixThera declines the split, fallback plan: keep 10–11 as a single hands-on (Marco + Alice) and reschedule Meridian to Tuesday afternoon.

Alice Chen: Good contingency. Can we lock this in by EOD so docs + runbooks update?

Raj Patel: I’ll update the shared agenda and drop a note in the customer success calendar.

Elena (cs_ops): Locked provisional changes in calendar, added note "pending customer confirmation".

Alice Chen: Thanks all — tagging this resolved for now. I’ll follow up once customers confirm. :white_check_mark:
